title: Single generic query_soccer SQL tool instead of discrete per-capability handlers
evidence: main.m:4 tool() registers one tool 'query_soccer' taking arbitrary SQL; all R3-R11 capabilities are satisfied via the SQLite schema/views (matches, team_results, standings, rivals, players) rather than named tools
suggestion: Acceptable design — the rich tool description documents the schema so an LLM composes queries; noting only that R1's 'tools/handlers for the queries' is met by one tool + schema, not per-query handlers

title: Tool executes arbitrary LLM-supplied SQL
evidence: Graph.m:173 query: runs caller SQL via sqlite3_prepare_v2; mitigated by sqlite3_set_authorizer denying writes and load_extension (Graph.m:106-109, 168), a 4s progress-handler deadline (Graph.m:181-182) and a 100-row page cap (Graph.m:186)
suggestion: Mitigations are reasonable for a read-only demo over an in-memory DB; no action required

title: Copa do Brasil 'final' stage inferred from hardcoded per-year round counts
evidence: Graph.m:141 finalRound=year==2012?6:year==2016?7:year==2021?7:8 and Graph.m:161-162 reversed-legs heuristic label only seasons matching the pattern
suggestion: Heuristic covers the test seasons but may mislabel stages for years not enumerated; fine for the bundled data
